question: does CANN 9.1 / Ascend 310P3 (dav-2002) provide a reliable in-kernel timestamp for AI Core kernels?
verdict: NO - GetSystemCycle() is a compile-pass/run-zero stub on this SoC; no other documented low-overhead AI Core timestamp exists for the inference series; Gate B device-instrumentation route stays No-Go

compile_stage.toolchain: bisheng (CANN 9.1.0, /usr/local/Ascend/cann-9.1.0/bin/bisheng) --npu-arch=dav-2002, same flags as production libmf310p_v2_trial_device.so build
compile_stage.negative_control: a deliberately undefined function under the same -D guard fails compilation, proving the probe path is exercised
compile_stage.implication: compile success alone would have produced a false 'supported' answer; runtime probe was mandatory

runtime_stage.probe: mf_timing_probe_kernel<<<8,0,stream>>> on idle dev0 (card 5664); each core reads GetSystemCycle() 3 times around a 200k-iteration loop, writes 64B slot + cache clean; 6 launches, 200ms apart, <2s total
runtime_stage.execution_proof: magic 0xC0DE2026 and loop accumulator 19999900000 returned correctly from all 8 cores on all 6 launches
runtime_stage.result: c0=c1=c2=0 on ALL cores, ALL launches (see raw_probe/getsystemcycle_probe_result.json)

evidence.documentation_alignment: CANN 9.1 public API matrix lists GetSystemCycle(ISASI) / PrintTimeStamp as unsupported for the Atlas inference-series AI Core; the observed zero-return matches the doc
evidence.printtimestamp: not runtime-tested this round; doc-marked unsupported; irrelevant as a numeric source regardless
evidence.register_guessing: prohibited by Gate B design; not attempted

consequence_for_gate_b: no per-phase in-kernel timestamps will be produced; the controlled-isolation variant route (existing diagnostics + external profiler, relative deltas only) is the only admissible measurement style
side_observation: profiler attribution artifact identified while auditing: the V2 arm's single ~15s 'aclnnInplaceCopy' Device Self Duration equals the persistent HybmSdmaOrchEpoch AI_CPU kernel duration to ~1us - artifact, not a blocking copy
